shorts.title: The Dancing Plague of 1518 Was REAL 🔍
shorts.description:
What if I told you dozens of people once danced for days and couldn't stop? It happened in Strasbourg in July 1518. The physician Paracelsus wrote about it a few years later.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths
